result.topic_en: This is not a Riemann manuscript but page 2 of a printed bookseller's catalogue section 'Mathematik', listing mathematics books by authors from Wagner to Wolf with format, place, year, binding and prices; a mirrored stamp of the bookseller Ermanno Loescher, Turin, shows through from the other side.
